headline: New in ScottiBYTE Assist Linux 2.2.4
summary: Linux 2.2.4 adds automatic recovery when the Wayland portal disconnects or becomes unavailable. Assist attempts one restart of the GNOME and desktop portal services, then creates a fresh sharing session. One amd64 installer supports Ubuntu 24.04 LTS and Ubuntu 26.04 LTS. Windows remains at 2.2.0.
